ModInfo.Name: FF8 Smooth Frames
ModInfo.Author: todi
ModInfo.Description:
Plays battles, the world map and fields at high frame rates (144 fps by default, see Configure Mod) without speeding the game up. The game logic keeps its original 15/30 fps timing. Characters, the camera and battle effects are interpolated between logic steps.
Requires: FF8 in English, either the Steam 2013 version (FF8_EN.exe) or the Remastered version set up in Junction VIII (ff8.exe), and stock FFNx 1.24.3 or newer, as installed by Junction VIII. FFNx's ff8_fps_limiter must stay at 1 (the default), 2 or 3.
Not smoothed yet: menus, card game, results screens, flipbook sprites. Odin's summon is still being worked on. Do not combine with an FFNx build that has interpolation built in.
If something looks wrong, turn on Diagnostic log in Configure Mod and check ff8interp.log in the game folder.
ModInfo.ReleaseNotes: 0.4: Remastered support through Junction VIII; summons paced; smoother weapons, spell effects and battle windows; field camera scrolling, draw point sparkles and dialogue windows at the right speed; draw point menu no longer reopens after "Don't draw". 0.3: frame rate and diagnostic log in Configure Mod. 0.2: first public release.

ConfigOption.Name: Frame rate
ConfigOption.Description: Frames per second in battles, on the world map and in fields. The game keeps its normal speed. With vsync on, your display's refresh rate is the upper limit.

ConfigOption.Name: Diagnostic log
ConfigOption.Description: Writes one status line per second to ff8interp.log in the game folder. Turn on when reporting a problem.
